    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersMC State crab cakesPanko crumbed crab cakes with lemon and chipotle mayoHow to make it400g crab meat7 tbsp mayonnaise1 egg2 spring onions, sliced1 lemon1 tsp Dijon mustard120g panko breadcrumbs3 tbsp vegetable oil1 chipotle in adobo, chopped1 limeMix the crab with some of the mayonnaise, egg, spring onions, lemon zest, mustard and half the panko.Shape into small cakes and chill.Roll the cakes in the remaining panko.Fry in oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.Mix the remaining mayonnaise with the chipotle and a squeeze of lime. Serve with lime wedges.Frat house sticky barbecue wingsCrisp baked wings tossed in sticky barbecue sauceHow to make it1.2kg chicken wings2 tsp baking powder1 tsp smoked paprika200ml barbecue sauce2 tbsp honey1 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp cider vinegar1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted2 spring onions, slicedToss the wings with the baking powder, paprika and salt.Bake on a rack at 220°C, turning once.Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey, soy and vinegar until sticky.Toss the hot wings in the glaze and return to the oven.Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.MainsCaptain Dickson's fish tacosLager-battered flathead, slaw, chipotle crema in warm tortillasHow to make it1 red onion, sliced4 limes150g plain flour1 tsp baking powder250ml cold lager600g flathead fillets, cut into strips1 L vegetable oil, for frying1/2 cabbage, shredded150g sour cream1 tsp chipotle sauce12 small flour tortillas1 small bunch corianderSoak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt.Whisk the flour, baking powder and lager to a batter.Dip the flathead strips in the batter and fry in the oil at 180°C until golden, working in batches.Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix the sour cream with the chipotle sauce.Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.Spring break carne asada burritosSpring break in Puerto Mexico, still on the jobHow to make it800g skirt steak3 limes3 garlic cloves1 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp olive oil200g long grain rice400g tinned black beans, drained3 tomatoes1 red onion1 coriander1 jalapeño4 large flour tortillas150g sour cream100g cheddar, gratedRub the steak with the juice of 2 limes, crushed garlic, cumin, oil and salt and leave for 30 minutes.Simmer the rice with 400ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, rest for 5, then stir through the beans.Dice the tomatoes, onion and jalapeño and mix with chopped coriander and the last lime for the pico de gallo.Grill the steak very hot for 3 minutes a side, rest for 5 minutes and slice thin across the grain.Warm the tortillas, fill with rice and beans, steak, cheddar, pico de gallo and sour cream, and roll up tight.SweetsDining hall pan choc chip cookieGiant chocolate chip cookie baked in a panHow to make it125g butter, melted150g brown sugar50g caster sugar1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract200g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda150g chocolate chips4 scoops of vanilla ice cream1 bottle chocolate sauceBeat the butter with both sugars, the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, bicarbonate of soda, a pinch of salt and chocolate chips.Press into a greased 25cm ovenproof frying pan.Bake at 180°C until golden at the edges but still soft in the centre.Rest, then top with ice cream and drizzle with chocolate sauce. Serve with spoons.DrinksSpring break frozen mango margaritaFrozen mango, tequila, orange liqueur and lime with a salted rimHow to make it5 limes1 tbsp sea salt flakes400g frozen mango160ml tequila60ml orange liqueur2 tbsp sugar syrup1 bag iceRub a lime wedge around the rims of the glasses and dip in sea salt flakes.Blend the mango, tequila, orange liqueur, lime juice, sugar syrup and ice until thick and smooth.Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels.
